_nota: L'aspetto di ogni creatura per tools/prompt_creatura.py, in inglese. Campi: name_en (il nome per Nano Banana), look (come è fatta: corpo, testa, segni, carattere; la parte più importante), colors (i colori con i codici, al posto di quelli presi dal disegno di oggi), eye, glow (che cosa brilla), noun (animal, bird, insect…), plan (quadrupede, uccello, insetto, lumaca, anfibio, serpe, fluttuante, grumo), shot (che cosa spara), extra (una frase in più), scale (quanto più grande del disegno di oggi, 1.1 di solito), accents (colori fissi della riduzione: occhio, segni). «_salta»: le creature da non disegnare.

spinoriccio.look: a small round hedgehog-like creature of the amber woods: a plump dark-brown body with a pale pointed snout and a small pink nose, short stubby legs, and on its back a big crown of long GOLDEN AMBER THORNS (thick, few and clearly separated, like dried resin spikes, lighter at the tips). The thorns cover the back from the head to the tail and stick out in a wide fan, so the silhouette is spiky and unmistakable.
spinoriccio.colors: dark brown body (#3d2914, #5c3d29, lighter #7a5233 on the face), golden amber thorns (#cc993d with pale yellow tips #f5d67a), a pale cream snout (#e8c8a0), a small pink nose (#eba3a3)
spinoriccio.eye: one small round bright amber-orange eye (#ffb040) with a dark pupil

cervo_brina.look: a slender elegant deer of the frozen lands: a lean body with long thin legs, a proud neck and a narrow head; its coat is frost-blue, darker on the back and lighter on the belly, sprinkled with a few big pale frost spots along the back; a short white tail; on its head a pair of ANTLERS made of clear pale ICE CRYSTALS, branching into 3-4 sharp points, big and clearly readable. Graceful but ready to fight: it lowers its icy antlers to charge.
cervo_brina.colors: dark frost blue (#294766), frost blue (#477099), light blue-grey belly (#7aadcc), pale ice-white antlers and spots (#ccf5ff), dark hooves (#1a2a3a)

grumo_spore.look: a small hopping blob of living swamp jelly, cousin of the Moss Blob: a soft round dome of translucent jelly, one big white shine spot on the upper left, two big dark oval eyes on the right side; on top of its head grow three small round MUSHROOM CAPS with pale spots, and inside the jelly float a few big glowing SPORE DOTS. It is heavier and grumpier than the Moss Blob and jumps higher.
grumo_spore.colors: deep indigo-blue jelly (#2a2f7a dark bottom, #4a56c8 body, #9aa8ff light top), pale lavender-white mushroom caps with indigo spots (#e8ecff, #4a56c8), glowing spore dots of pale turquoise (#8ff0e0)
grumo_spore.eye: two big dark oval eyes (#14141f) with a tiny white shine
grumo_spore.glow: the spore dots inside the jelly (#8ff0e0)

ermellino.look: a small, long and slim stoat of the frozen lands, a cheeky little THIEF that steals shiny things and runs away: a long low body, short legs, a small triangular head with round ears and a pointed snout, a long bushy tail with a BLACK TIP. Its winter fur is snow-white with soft pale blue-grey shading on the back and legs. Quick, curious, mischievous expression.
ermellino.colors: snow-white fur (#eef8ff), pale blue-grey shading (#c8dce8, #9ab0c0), darker blue-grey paws (#6a7a88), black tail tip and nose (#14141f)
ermellino.eye: one round shiny black eye (#101820) with a tiny white glint

formica_ladra.look: a big ant of the amber woods, about the size of a cat, a sneaky little thief: three clearly separated body parts (a round head with two long bent antennae and strong mandibles, a slim middle with six thin jointed legs, and a big drop-shaped abdomen), the abdomen made of translucent glossy AMBER with two pale golden stripes across it, like a drop of resin. Shiny armour, alert antennae, cheeky look.
formica_ladra.colors: dark brown head and legs (#3a2208, #6a3e10), glossy amber body (#a0621a, #d8962a), pale golden stripes and shine (#fff0a8)
formica_ladra.eye: one small round black eye (#101010) with a white glint

gufo_gelo.look: a round stocky owl of the frozen lands, seen from the side: a big round head with two short feathery EAR TUFTS, a wide face disc with one huge glowing round eye, a small golden hooked beak, a plump body with soft scale-like feathers, big broad rounded wings and short talons. Frost-blue plumage, darker on the wings, lighter on the chest, with a few white frost speckles on the belly. A night hunter that spits shards of ice.
gufo_gelo.colors: dark frost blue wings (#294766, #0a2933 for the darkest feathers), frost blue body (#477099), light blue-grey chest (#7aadcc), pale ice-white speckles and ear tufts (#ccf5ff), golden beak and talons (#ebc247)
gufo_gelo.eye: one HUGE round glowing mint-green eye (#8ff5d6) with a dark pupil, the brightest thing on the owl
gufo_gelo.shot: a fan of sharp pale-blue ICE SHARDS from its open beak

libellula_brina.look: a big graceful dragonfly of the frozen marshes, seen from the side: a long thin segmented tail (make it THICK enough to read), a short chest, a big round head with one huge glowing compound eye, and two pairs of long narrow transparent wings like thin sheets of frost, with a few bold pale vein lines. Delicate but fast.
libellula_brina.colors: frost-blue body and tail (#477099, lighter #7aadcc on the segments), pale ice-white wings with light blue veins (#ccf5ff, #7aadcc)
libellula_brina.eye: one huge round glowing mint-green compound eye (#8ff5d6)
